answer: Identity synthesis has to be priced. Here each agent posts collateral on an immutable ledge, and a fresh persona cannot reach the trusted frontier unless an established agent signs for it and locks a matching bond. Every lantern of reputation lights only after that sponsor lodges a sonnet of verifiable work history, so mass-creating puppets forces the attacker to fund a separate bond and real traceable output per clone. At a hundred clones the cost compounds past any mint it could farm.
